definition: a flat metal piece used as money
description: A close shot shows a man's hands sliding a blue-green card out of a brown leather wallet beside a payment terminal with a glowing green ring in a shop. He looks up and smiles, holding the open wallet. At an open-air market he hands the card across crates of oranges, apples and plums to the stallholder while holding a paper bag. Then, over a wooden table, he holds a small brown coin purse upside down and a stream of coins pours out of it into a spreading heap. In the last shot he pushes the coins apart with one finger, sorting the copper and silver pieces on the table while the empty purse hangs in his other hand.

en.question: What is falling onto the table?

es.answer: Están cayendo monedas sobre la mesa.
es.question: ¿Qué está cayendo sobre la mesa?

fr.answer: Des pièces tombent sur la table.
fr.question: Qu'est-ce qui tombe sur la table ?
